agent_explanation: Shrunk 2-body scenario has high G and large dt (0.033) with bodies starting 2.3 apart moving toward close encounter. By step 8 distance 0.52 and by step 9 distance 0.15 with very deep potential (-1054) and kinetic ~929. Leapfrog substeps (19-25) insufficient to resolve steep softened gravity at close approach, causing energy drift from -82.6 to -125.7 exceeding allowed 39.73. Reducing dt to 0.005 with same steps conserves energy, confirming numerical integration error, not physics.
